scientific_question: Can a causal observation-visible keyframe gate and fit-only diagonal transport reuse the compact CNN dual proposal on the already consumed p=33kw_size=03 public development trajectory, preserve the frozen v16 field/gradient/observation envelope and 2A+2A^T solver ledger, and remove at least 20% of per-frame CNN executions before any new resource profile is authorized?

fit_only_selection.selection_role: leave_one_fit_trajectory_out mechanism selection before p=33kw_size=03 temporal scoring
fit_only_selection.selection_evidence_required: all five held-out fit trajectories independently pass the unchanged v16 compatibility envelope, joint/per-metric harm limits, and zero severe harm
fit_only_selection.threshold: median of adjacent-frame relative observation changes from the calibration trajectories only
fit_only_selection.ridge: 1e-3 times the median positive coordinate energy sum(delta_y^2)

frozen_p33_arms.proposal: run compact CNN on all 101 frames
same causal gate; hold the latest exact CNN proposal
same causal gate; fit-only scalar delta transport
same causal gate; selected fit-only diagonal delta transport
fixed even-frame CNN execution with the same diagonal transport

solver.learned_and_temporal_arms: proposal -> exact A^T -> observable alpha clipped to [0,2] -> unchanged strict CGLS K1
solver.reference: zero initialization -> unchanged strict CGLS K4

decision_rule: The temporal headroom gate passes only if the selected diagonal policy reproduces its all-five fit-only leave-one-trajectory-out pass, passes the unchanged p33 compatibility and harm gates, executes the CNN on at most 80% of p33 frames, and preserves the exact 202A+202A^T ledger. Learned diagonal added value is reported separately against hold and scalar controls. No wall, CPU, RSS, independent generalization, real BOST, or paper claim is authorized by this experiment.

failure_actions.fit_only_loto_reproduction_failure: invalidate v18 without reading p33 temporal scores
failure_actions.p33_accuracy_or_amortization_failure: freeze a negative post-open temporal result and do not open fresh or test data
failure_actions.temporal_headroom_pass_but_added_value_f: retain simple temporal reuse headroom only and do not claim learned transport value
failure_actions.all_gates_pass: freeze a separate native resource profile before any wall, CPU, or RSS claim
